help:
usage: gnd exp run [-h] [--adapter {claude,codex}]
                   [--adapter-policy ADAPTER_POLICY]
                   [--wall-seconds WALL_SECONDS] [--test-argv WORD]
                   directory

Load a kind: data-driven SPEC.md and its conventional session.contract.json,
invoke exactly one trusted terminal-agent adapter, run GND's machine verifier
over every declared case, and publish immutable evidence under runs/. The
adapter vocabulary is closed; no executable, provider, model, argv, attempt
increase, or contract-bound loosening is accepted. This does not close the
experiment: gnd exp close remains the separate completeness gate. Exits 0 on
exact required-case acceptance, 15 on a well-formed nonaccepted session, 3 on
malformed or mismatched committed input, 64 on usage errors or a wall-bound
loosening, 66 when a required artifact or selected adapter is missing, 70 on
an internal defect, 74 on refused or failed path/I/O. Child verifier exits 1
through 4 are retained as case evidence and never become this parent exit.

positional arguments:
  directory             the data-driven experiment directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --adapter {claude,codex}
                        legacy trusted terminal-agent adapter (contracts
                        v1-v5)
  --adapter-policy ADAPTER_POLICY
                        trusted local declared-adapter policy path (contracts
                        v6/v7; v7 supports bounded patches and ranking)
  --wall-seconds WALL_SECONDS
                        optional positive finite tightening of the contract
                        wall bound
  --test-argv WORD      one exact tests-mode child argv word; repeatable and
                        never shell-parsed
